lines.cap: Sitting all day is literally killing your butt.
lines.say: Sitting all day is literally killing your butt.

lines.cap: Eight, nine, ten hours in a chair. Your glutes just sit there, squashed.
lines.say: Eight, nine, ten hours in a chair. Your glutes just sit there, squashed.

lines.cap: Over time, they can forget how to switch on. Doctors call it gluteal amnesia. Or, dead butt syndrome.
lines.say: Over time, they can forget how to switch on. Doctors call it gluteal amnesia. Or, dead butt syndrome.

lines.cap: Meanwhile, the muscles at the front of your hips get short and tight.
lines.say: Meanwhile, the muscles at the front of your hips get short and tight.

lines.cap: So other muscles take over the work. Hello, back pain, hip pain, and sore knees.
lines.say: So other muscles take over the work. Hello, back pain, hip pain, and sore knees.

lines.cap: Quick test. Stand on one leg. If your hip sags to one side, your glutes may not be doing their job.
lines.say: Quick test. Stand on one leg. If your hip sags to one side, your glutes may not be doing their job.

lines.cap: The fix is easy. Every thirty to sixty minutes, stand up, and squeeze your glutes.
lines.say: The fix is easy. Every thirty to sixty minutes, stand up, and squeeze your glutes.

lines.cap: Add bridges and squats. Ten of each, every day.
lines.say: Add bridges and squats. Ten of each, every day.

lines.cap: Wake up your butt. It's been asleep long enough.
lines.say: Wake up your butt. It's been asleep long enough.
